stage0011_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$リディ$$
「So, you're the pilot of that AT?」

stage0011_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Riddhe
「I'm Ensign $$リディ・マーセナス$$.
　I look forward to working with you.」

stage0011_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Chirico
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$.」

stage0011_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$リディ$$
「I saw your piloting skill in the last battle.
　How about running a simulated mock battle
　with me?」

stage0011_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$葵$$
「It's no use, Ensign.
　He won't lift a finger for anything
　that doesn't interest him.」

stage0011_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$リディ$$
「But didn't he accept the scout because
　he agreed with $$ミスリル$$'s cause?」

stage0011_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then he could show a little interest
　in those of us fighting beside him.」

stage0011_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$くらら$$
「I don't think that logic works on him.」

stage0011_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Then again, none of us have any idea
　why he joined $$ミスリル$$ in the first
　place either.」

stage0011_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then will you two spar with me?
　$$カミーユ$$ and $$ファ$$ seem to be heading out...」

stage0011_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Sorry, Ensign $$リディ$$.
　We're going with $$カミーユ$$ and the others too.」

stage0011_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Since you're on leave too, Ensign,
　care to join? Should be a fun catch to watch.」

stage0011_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「...So we just need to catch this
　weirdo, '$$ぽに男$$'?」

stage0011_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アルト$$
「But seriously, what is this '$$ぽに男$$'...?」

stage0011_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「The name '$$ぽに男$$' wasn't self-given...
　it's what people who heard of the case
　call him, from his peculiar behavior.」

stage0011_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$n
「Apparently the only thing he says
　is 'poni'. Beyond that, his looks
　are just speculationtheories vary.」

stage0011_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$n
「The most common account: a half-man,
　half-beast monsterhorse legs, racehorse
　speed, horse-snorts, and loves carrots...」

stage0011_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$n
「Some say a prince on a white horse,
　others a Pegasus, a Unicorn, a Centaur...
　And then there's his behavior...」

stage0011_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$n
「No wonder you're shocked.
　It is pretty startling information.」

stage0011_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That $$ぽに男$$ thing was shocking enough...」

stage0011_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$さやか$$
「I... think that's the most I've ever
　heard $n talk...」

stage0011_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　You never bring up topics on your own.」

stage0011_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「A different flavor of quiet type than $$宗介$$.」

stage0011_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Still, $n...
　you sure know a lot of stuff.」

stage0011_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I... only told you the name $$ぽに男$$...
　Did you look the rest up yourself?」

stage0011_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
「It's from digging through posts on 《$$オカルトフォーラム$$》.」

stage0011_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's a site on 《$$ＵＮ$$》 only insiders know.
　All kinds of sightings and theories on
　strange phenomena gather there.」

stage0011_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「Huh... so $n likes the occult...
　Didn't expect that.」

stage0011_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Guess Miss $$スズネ$$ knows a lot about it too.」

stage0011_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$クラン$$
「What's with that blatant subject change!?」

stage0011_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, come on, it's fine.
　...Now then, $l... please continue
　with the $$ぽに男$$ information.」

stage0011_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait...!
　Sousuke's missing again, isn't he...?」

stage0011_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$甲児$$
「He said something about needing proper
　gear to chase down a weirdo, then left...」

stage0011_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Proper gear...?
　I've got a bad feeling again...」

stage0011_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Dealing with things like that too is
　what the Volunteer Club does, Chidori.」

stage0011_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's easy for you to say, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　The more I hear about this $$ぽに男$$,
　the less motivated I get.」

stage0011_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルト$$
「I feel the same.
　Let $$正太郎$$ handle the arrest for that one.」

stage0011_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Having $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ step in seems like the bigger deal...」

stage0011_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, what $$ぽに男$$ actually does is...」

stage0011_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Bad news.
　Last night, Tokiwa was attacked by that weirdo.」

stage0011_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$宗介$$
「Unfortunately...
　I don't know how to put this...」

stage0011_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$宗介$$
「She was caught before she could fight back,
　forced down despite her desperate resistance...」

stage0011_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$クラン$$
「Stop!
　I don't want to hear what comes next!」

stage0011_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宗介$$
「Her hair was thoroughly brushed out,
　and then put up in a ponytail.」

stage0011_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アルト$$
「...What is that supposed to mean?」

stage0011_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Here's a photo of Tokiwa, for reference.」

stage0011_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Different vibe than usual, but hey,
　there's something to this too!」

stage0011_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$n
「As you all just heard.
　That's also where '$$ぽに男$$' gets its name.」

stage0011_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So, what...?
　We're after a weirdo who cries 'poni'
　and turns girls' hair into ponytails...?」

stage0011_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「Then you all don't need to come.」

stage0011_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$n
「Now that a classmate's been hurt too,
　we don't have a moment to spare.」

stage0011_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アルト$$
「$n's right, no doubt about it.」

stage0011_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's right...!
　I regret how half-hearted I've been about this!」

stage0011_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「As the Volunteer Club, and Kyoko's friend,
　I will absolutely catch that $$ぽに男$$!」

stage0011_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I brought $$ジョナサン$$ along as our police dog!」

stage0011_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If I make them work this late,
　I'd have to pay overtime, you know.」

stage0011_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see.
　Guess that wouldn't really be volunteering then.」

stage0011_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But it's fine!
　With the plan $$正太郎$$ came up with,
　we can arrest anybody, guaranteed!」

stage0011_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Count on you, elementary schoolers!
　And of course, you high schoolers too!」

stage0011_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... now that we've come this far,
　we're giving it our all too.」

stage0011_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「We've got backup from the Quarter and
　the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ too.」

stage0011_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke's comrades, huh...
　Let's work together, everyone.」

stage0011_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You helped us out in the last battle, after all.」

stage0011_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Now that we're here,
　you can just leave it all to us.」

stage0011_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Got it.
　I'll be counting on you.」

stage0011_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$葵$$
「So, do we have any leads on the culprit?」

stage0011_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$くらら$$
「Isn't that tough?
　$$第２新東京市$$'s a new city, so there's
　a lot of people coming and going...」

stage0011_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$くらら$$
「Tokyo's pushing ahead with waterfront
　development too, so a lot of migrant
　workers come in for construction jobs.」

stage0011_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「But if we scatter enough bait like this,
　the culprit's sure to bite!」

stage0011_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry.
　You all came all this way, and now
　we're asking the girls to be decoys.」

stage0011_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$葵$$
「Don't worry about it.
　We... don't mind this kind of thing.」

stage0011_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ファ$$
「$$アルト$$ and the others have been in your
　care, so let us help, as a thank-you.」

stage0011_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now, let me explain $$正太郎$$'s plan.
　Each girl walks her assigned area alone
　to lure $$ぽに男$$ out.」

stage0011_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Each guard stays within 50 meters,
　protecting the girl while watching for $$ぽに男$$.」

stage0011_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$ patrol with $$ジョナサン$$,
　while $$宗介$$ and $n act as a strike team,
　using your own judgment.」

stage0011_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アルト$$
「What is it, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0011_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No... it's nothing, $$アルト$$.
　Don't worry about it.」

stage0011_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アルト$$
「As mission commander, I'll direct things
　from HQ. Good luck to you all.」

stage0011_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We're catching $$ぽに男$$ no matter what!」

stage0011_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$n
「The monster attacking people... I will find it...!」

stage0011_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$宗介$$
「The target's movements... what do you make of them?」

stage0011_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「There's no pattern to when $$ぽに男$$ shows up.
　In other words, he's just acting on
　whatever impulse takes him, I'd guess.」

stage0011_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$宗介$$
「So even an ambush with traps you're
　good at won't work here...?」

stage0011_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$n
「Before that, setting traps in a city is the issue...」

stage0011_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$宗介$$
「If it serves the mission,
　some collateral damage is acceptable.」

stage0011_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$n
「...That $$アルト$$...
　Talked big, then dumped $$宗介$$ on me...」

stage0011_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Let's go, $n.
　On to the next block.」

stage0011_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
「Wait, $$宗介$$.
　Didn't you have equipment ready
　just for hunting $$ぽに男$$?」

stage0011_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Now is not the time.
　I'll use it if the target's too much to handle.」

stage0011_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$陽子$$
「You two... got a minute?
　I'm with the police, a few questions?」

stage0011_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$n
（Don't get any funny ideas, $$宗介$$.
　That woman's a police officer.）

stage0011_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$n
（Just explain that we're volunteering
　of our own free will, and get her to understand.）

stage0011_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$陽子$$
「You look like high schoolers,
　so what are you doing out this late?」

stage0011_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem here.
　We're just doing what we want to do.」

stage0011_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$陽子$$
「What's that supposed to mean?
　Some kind of naked desire?」

stage0011_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$n
「W-wait, $$宗介$$!
　That makes it sound like...」

stage0011_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$陽子$$
「Thanks to going overboard in Traffic,
　I got stuck on desk duty. But if I catch
　that rumored pervert, I'm back in the field!」

stage0011_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
「Run, $$宗介$$!
　This woman's not right in the head!」

stage0011_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$陽子$$
「That's rich, coming from a criminal!!」

stage0011_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$宗介$$
「The target's movements... what do you make of them?」

stage0011_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$n
「There's no pattern to when $$ぽに男$$ shows up.
　In other words, he's just acting on
　whatever impulse takes him, I'd guess.」

stage0011_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$宗介$$
「You used to be a $$ハンター$$, didn't you?
　Can't you put that tracking skill to use?」

stage0011_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$n
「If we knew the target's behavior pattern,
　a trap could work, but...」

stage0011_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then we'll have to trap every possible spot.」

stage0011_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$n
「Calm down.
　Think about what trapping the city would cause.」

stage0011_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$宗介$$
「If it serves the mission,
　some collateral damage is acceptable.」

stage0011_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$n
「...That $$アルト$$...
　Talked big, then dumped $$宗介$$ on me...」

stage0011_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Let's go, $n.
　On to the next block.」

stage0011_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$n
「Wait, $$宗介$$.
　Didn't you have equipment ready
　just for hunting $$ぽに男$$?」

stage0011_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Now is not the time.
　I'll use it if the target's too much to handle.」

stage0011_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$陽子$$
「You two... got a minute?
　I'm with the police, a few questions?」

stage0011_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$n
（Don't get any funny ideas, $$宗介$$.
　That woman's a police officer.）

stage0011_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$n
（Just explain that we're volunteering
　of our own free will, and get her to understand.）

stage0011_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$陽子$$
「You look like high schoolers,
　so what are you doing out this late?」

stage0011_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem here.
　We're just doing what we want to do.」

stage0011_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$陽子$$
「What's that supposed to mean?
　Some kind of naked desire?」

stage0011_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$n
「W-wait, $$宗介$$!
　That makes it sound like...」

stage0011_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$陽子$$
「Thanks to going overboard in Traffic,
　I got stuck on desk duty. But if I catch
　that rumored pervert, I'm back in the field!」

stage0011_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$n
「Run, $$宗介$$!
　This woman's not right in the head!」

stage0011_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$陽子$$
「That's rich, coming from a criminal!!」

stage0011_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宗介$$
「That much combat ability, and a woman at that...
　It shows how capable Japan's police force is.」

stage0011_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「She must be one in a million...」

stage0011_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
???
「So it's you two, huh...?
　The pervert the police are after.」

stage0011_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
???
「Thought you'd given us the slip? Too bad.
　Running into us is where your luck ran out.」

stage0011_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$宗介$$
「This killing intent...!
　These aren't ordinary men!」

stage0011_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You may be young, but I won't go easy!」

stage0011_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Dodged my straight punch...!
　You're no ordinary kid!」

stage0011_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Seems this one's had some training.」

stage0011_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So he's a terrorist wearing a pervert's skin...!」

stage0011_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Go on ahead, $n!
　With your strength, you can shake these guys!」

stage0011_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't worry about me!
　Focus on completing the mission first!」

stage0011_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You think you can outrun me!?」

stage0011_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Ugh! What's that supposed to mean!?」

stage0011_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$葵$$
「I don't like it.
　And after all us pretty girls played decoy...」

stage0011_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ファ$$
「And still $$アルト$$'s the one who got picked...」

stage0011_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Been a while since I've seen your 'Princess' powers.」

stage0011_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Is this really the time for that!?」

stage0011_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アルト$$
「Seems when I swung at him without thinking,
　I hit him just right, he's out cold in those bushes.」

stage0011_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Looks like he's coming to!」

stage0011_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$朔哉$$
「All right, let's get a look at this pervert's face!」

stage0011_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sure, he's a half-man, half-beast monster, but...」

stage0011_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This... this is it!
　This is the $$ぽに男$$ we tried to catch
　even at the cost of our own pride!」

stage0011_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Like hell I'll let you go!
　I'm ripping that costume right off!!」

stage0011_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's wrong, $$葵$$!
　You have to say 《$$新世界大陸$$》 now!」

stage0011_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
Beastman
「Don't worry, brother!
　I'll save you now!!」

stage0011_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「...Do you understand what you've done?」

stage0011_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「'Yes' alone tells me nothing!」

stage0011_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
Beastman
「We ignored what we'd done ourselves and
　turned a misplaced grudge on the humans around us!」

stage0011_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
Beastman
「In the end, we even brought out Gunmen
　and tried to destroy the city!」

stage0011_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It's time you all understood already.
　This is an age where Beastmen and humans coexist.」

stage0011_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
Beastman
「...But, Captain $$ヴィラル$$, you used to call
　humans 'hairless monkeys' too...」

stage0011_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
Beastman
「S-sorry!
　I shouldn't have said that...」

stage0011_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But I changed.
　I met a human I trust to my very core.」

stage0011_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You'll understand someday too...
　that humans aren't so bad after all.」

stage0011_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
Beastman
「I won't be fooled again!
　You're actually human, aren't you!」

stage0011_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
Beastman
「You... are you worried about us?」

stage0011_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
Beastman
「There's a human who cares about wretches like us...」

stage0011_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
Beastman
「...I... I understand now what Captain $$ヴィラル$$ meant...」

stage0011_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
Beastman
「Thanks, $$ぽに男$$.
　We'll atone properly and come see you again.」

stage0011_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$さやか$$
「And here I thought this might be a touching scene...」

stage0011_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That's how it is, $$竜馬$$.
　I'll take responsibility for them
　and bring them back to the $$新世界大陸$$.」

stage0011_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... I came on an errand for $$シモン$$,
　but I never expected to run into you here.」

stage0011_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Same here.
　Next time we meet, let's drink till dawn again.」

stage0011_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Right.
　$$シモン$$ and the others should join us next time.」

stage0011_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ぽに男$$...
　You should be able to admit your own crimes now.」

stage0011_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Will you tell us why you did something like that?」

stage0011_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「Aw c'mon, ponytails are the best, right?」

stage0011_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「The sexy nape of a short cut,
　the soft femininity of long hair...
　it perfectly combines both, contradiction and all!」

stage0011_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「And yet,
　lately I never see ponytail girls anymore,
　and it makes me so sad, so sad...」

stage0011_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's why you did that?」

stage0011_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「But I've got no regrets!
　'Cause I lived true to myself...!」

stage0011_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「And I learned something!
　The passionate feelings of those Beastmen...!」

stage0011_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ぽに男$$
「So I...!
　I'm looking forward to seeing them again someday!」

stage0011_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's a story for after you've reformed.」

stage0011_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$陽子$$
「I'll take it from here.
　Now, tell me the rest at the station.」

stage0011_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「For now, eat some jailhouse rice and reflect on it.」

stage0011_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course.
　I have no sympathy for the pervert
　who laid a hand on my precious student.」

stage0011_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No... there's still one big problem left.」

stage0011_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke!
　I knew it was you!」

stage0011_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$n
「So that's the anti-pervert gear you meant...」

stage0011_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is a cheaply-sourced costume fitted with
　sensors, digital comms, ballistic resistance,
　and power assist, a kind of powered suit.」

stage0011_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Done right, this could completely
　change the face of urban warfare.」

stage0011_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sure, if the whole ground unit's out there
　saying 'fumofumo,' common sense would flip...!」

stage0011_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$n
「What in the world is with that way of talking?」

stage0011_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Even I don't fully understand it.
　The voice changer converts every word I say
　into that, no matter what.」

stage0011_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$宗介$$
「But if I turn that function off,
　the whole system goes down.
　There's still plenty of room for improvement.」

stage0011_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Since $n's group is too stunned to speak,
　I'll say it myself!」

stage0011_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Before any improvements, fix that mindset
　from the ground up, completely!!」

stage0011_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$さやか$$
「Too much happened, so I'm short on sleep.」

stage0011_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$甲児$$
「After that, I walked $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ home,
　then did homework, it was nearly dawn by then.」

stage0011_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But we cleared the council chair's assignment!
　Now the Volunteer Club is officially approved.」

stage0011_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アルト$$
「But problems are piling up.
　With $$宗介$$ around, we'll keep having to
　clean up after stunts like yesterday's.」

stage0011_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$かなめ$$
「About that, $$アルト$$...
　I talked it over with Ms. $$スズネ$$, and
　we want you to be the Volunteer Club's president.」

stage0011_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'm for it too.
　After all, $$アルト$$'s even served as
　acting Skull Leader before.」

stage0011_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah.
　Plus he's surprisingly considerate too.」

stage0011_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$n
「He looks right at home leading everyone, too.」

stage0011_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$かなめ$$'s better suited to keep $$宗介$$ in line, no?」

stage0011_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you talking about.
　If I became president, it'd look odd
　for me to be at school when everyone deploys.」

stage0011_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So, I'll be the manager.
　Now... my running of things ends here...
　I'll leave the rest to the president.」

stage0011_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$甲児$$
「The moment a new president is born, huh.」

stage0011_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is your president, to all hands.
　Starting today, we begin operating
　as the Volunteer Club!」

stage0011_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Roger that.
　Counting on you, President.」

stage0011_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Oi, you lot!
　Dawdle around there and you'll be late!」

stage0011_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$竜馬$$!
　Why are you at Jindai High!?」

stage0011_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't tell me you're enrolling too?」

stage0011_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's way too much of a stretch...」

stage0011_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$大貫$$
「Nagare will be working here at
　Jindai High from today, as caretaker's assistant.」

stage0011_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$大貫$$
「I'm getting on in years myself.
　Doing all the odd jobs around the school alone
　has gotten rough on me.」

stage0011_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My training journey finally ran out of money.
　So I figured settling into a steady job
　around here wouldn't be so bad.」

stage0011_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Course, I'll help out with
　your so-called Volunteer Club too.」

stage0011_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Got it!
　Keep training me from here on too!」

stage0011_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$宗介$$
「Heh... looks like this'll be a lively school.」

stage0011_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, forcing women's hairstyles into
　ponytails, what a terrifying man he was.」

stage0011_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「From what I hear,
　he'd force any hairstyle into a ponytail
　using wire and glue, apparently...」

stage0011_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With skills like that, he could've just
　worked at a salon, a savior for anyone
　struggling with stubborn hair who wants a change.」

stage0011_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops! Looks like I said something
　unnecessary! Well then, let's get to it today too...
　business, business!」
